Матеріал описуємо пасивом з made of: is: We describe material with the passive made of: is made (what it's made of now) or was made (what it was made from). Make, made, made.
Дена навчив дядько: was + V3. Teach, tau: Dan's uncle taught him: was + V3. Teach, taught, taught, so teached is a mistake.
Tomorrow і результати не оголошують себе: Tomorrow, and results don't announce themselves: future passive will be + V3.
Дія в майбутньому, а все підготують інші: The action is in the future and others will prepare everything: will be + V3.
Результат зараз: Present Perfect passive: Result now: Present Perfect passive, has been + V3. Order is singular, so has; send, sent, sent.
Видно результат: have been + V3. Walls у: You can see the result: have been + V3. Walls is plural, so have; have painted would mean the walls did the painting themselves.
By a famous singer і next month: майбутн: By a famous singer and next month: future passive will be + V3.
Yet and a result now: hasn’t been + V3. Laptop = it, so has; isn’t been doesn't exist.
Регулярна дія, слова вводить учитель: ar: A regular action, the teacher introduces the words: are + V3. Words is plural.
In 1960 і by his father: Past Simple pas: In 1960 and by his father: Past Simple passive, was + V3 made.
Матч скасують організатори в майбутньому: The organisers will cancel the match in the future: will be + V3. Will cancel would mean the match itself cancels something.
Її обрали, і результат важливий зараз: h: She was chosen and the result matters now: has been + V3. She, so has; choose, chose, chosen.
Есе написав брат (by) у минулому: was +: Her brother wrote the essay (by) in the past: was + V3 written.
Майбутній пасив: will be + V3 sent. Без: Future passive: will be + V3 sent. Without be it's not passive, and send is V1.
Every summer і is very popular: регулярн: Every summer and is very popular: a regular action now, is + V3. The museum doesn't visit tourists itself.
Свіжий результат зараз: has just been +: A fresh result now: has just been + V3, just goes between has and been. In American English was just fixed also works.
Yesterday and by him: Past Simple passive. Every dish is singular, so was + V3.
Телефони повернуть у майбутньому: will b: The phones will be returned in the future: will be + V3 returned. Will return would mean the phones come back by themselves.
For years і зв’язок із теперішнім: Prese: For years and a link to the present: Present Perfect passive, hasn’t been + V3.
Вчителя найняли: has been + V3. Has hire: The teacher was hired: has been + V3. Has hired would mean the teacher hired someone, and have doesn't agree with a singular subject.
Котика знайшли в минулому: was + V3. Fin: The cat was found in the past: was + V3. Find, found, found.
Next Saturday і фанатів повезуть: майбут: Next Saturday, and the fans will be taken: future passive will be + V3 taken.
